item.title: How Instagram Reels Are Pushing Smartphones to Become Better Content-Creation Tools
item.summary: Short-form video has changed the way people use their smartphones. Instagram Reels, in particular, have made video creation a daily activity for millions of users. People no longer need professional cameras, expensive computers, or complicated editing systems to create engaging videos.
